title.en: Building a Creator Video Platform: upload, discovery and delivery

summary.vi: Thiết kế catalog user uploads với long tail, generation-safe processing, rights gates, sharded metadata, retrieval/ranking, codec economics và short-video prefetch; đi qua 13 giai đoạn và ba mô phỏng.
summary.en: Design a user-uploaded catalog with long-tail delivery, generation-safe processing, rights gates, sharded metadata, retrieval/ranking, codec economics and short-video prefetch across thirteen stages and three experiments.

takeaways.vi: Upload hours quyết định source/encode/storage demand; watched seconds và bitrate quyết định media egress.
takeaways.en: Uploaded hours drive source/encoding/storage demand; watched seconds and bitrates drive media egress.

takeaways.vi: Baseline playable, optional enhancements và policy permission là các readiness states khác nhau.
takeaways.en: Baseline playback, optional enhancements and policy permission are distinct readiness states.

takeaways.vi: Retrieval misses không được ranker cứu; đo eligible recall từ evidence thay fake recall curve.
takeaways.en: Rankers cannot rescue retrieval misses; measure eligible recall from evidence rather than invented recall curves.

takeaways.vi: Codec payback phụ thuộc compatible watch duration, quality target và marginal costs, không chỉ view count.
takeaways.en: Codec payback depends on compatible watched duration, matched quality and marginal costs, not view counts alone.

takeaways.vi: Long-tail caching và short-feed prefetch cần useful-byte/cold-miss budgets, không blind cache mọi thứ.
takeaways.en: Long-tail caching and short-feed prefetch need useful-byte and cold-miss budgets rather than indiscriminate caching.

paragraphs.vi: Giả sử ai có quyền cũng upload clips: số uploads tăng độc lập views, nội dung/codec đầu vào đa dạng và phần lớn catalog có demand thấp. Vì vậy ingest/encode/storage scaling không suy từ watch requests. Bài này là original educational architecture lấy các product pressures làm stages; không claim topology, traffic hoặc algorithms production hiện tại của một công ty.
paragraphs.en: Assume authorized users can upload clips independently of viewing demand, with varied source formats and many rarely viewed items. Ingestion, encoding and storage therefore cannot be sized from watch requests alone. This educational architecture follows product pressures without claiming a company’s current private topology, traffic or algorithms.

paragraphs.vi: Bắt đầu bằng upload limits, video duration/resolution caps, privacy modes, processing/first-play target, supported clients, removal/review behavior và retention. Dùng case Video Platform cho ABR/processing DAG nền tảng; episode này mở rộng decisions theo catalog economics, discovery và lifecycle. Không gộp mọi metric thành requests/s.
paragraphs.en: Start with upload/duration/resolution limits, privacy modes, processing/first-play targets, clients, removal/review behavior and retention. The Video Platform case covers foundational ABR and processing DAGs; this episode adds catalog economics, discovery and lifecycle decisions. Do not reduce every metric to requests per second.

paragraphs.vi: Một state machine có thể tách SOURCE_UPLOADING → SOURCE_FINALIZED → BASELINE_READY; policy có PENDING/ALLOW/HOLD/BLOCK riêng. Public publication chỉ tham chiếu generation complete và selected policy/visibility version còn hợp lệ. Optional higher resolutions/codecs có thể xuất hiện sau, thay vì chờ mọi task của video hoàn tất.
paragraphs.en: Separate source uploading/finalization/baseline readiness from policy pending/allow/hold/block states. Public publication references a complete generation with a valid current visibility/policy decision. Optional resolutions/codecs can arrive later instead of waiting for every task.

paragraphs.vi: Finalize upload cần verify chunks/offset/source digest theo protocol rồi tạo immutable generation. Có transaction/outbox hoặc reconciler giữa finalized source và task queue; retry một event không spawn unlimited jobs. Mọi worker report giữ sourceGen, profileVersion, attempt identity và expected lifecycle. Delete/private/block có monotonic version/tombstone để old completion không republish.
paragraphs.en: Finalization verifies chunks/offsets/digests and creates an immutable generation. Use outboxes/reconciliation between finalized sources and queues, with retries that do not multiply jobs. Workers retain generation/profile/attempt/lifecycle context. Versioned deletion/privacy/blocking prevents stale completions from republishing.

paragraphs.vi: Mỗi stage có đường đi, problem, decision, trade-off và exit criteria. Không bắt một team nhỏ xây sharding, in-ISP hardware hoặc custom encoder chips ngay. Các bài toán vẫn tồn tại ở quy mô nhỏ: retry identity, public-state gating, bounded queues và removal correctness không phải optional scale feature.
paragraphs.en: Each stage exposes paths, problems, decisions, trade-offs and exit criteria. A small team need not build sharding, ISP hardware or custom encoder chips immediately. Retry identities, publication gates, bounded queues and correct removals still matter at small scale.

description.vi: MVP cần resumable upload, source finalize, một encode target, metadata lifecycle và watch page. Không encode trong HTTP request dài. Dù chỉ một app, media bytes nên đọc trực tiếp từ object/static serving path thay buộc API proxy mọi byte.
description.en: The MVP needs resumable uploads, source finalization, one encode target, lifecycle metadata and a watch page. Avoid encoding inside long HTTP requests. Even one application can serve media through a separate object/static path rather than API-proxying every byte.

exitCriteria.en: Resumption preserves source identity and public links never reference missing assets.

rows.vi: Reject stale result; orphan artifact có cleanup, không hồi sinh video.
rows.en: Reject stale results; clean up orphan artifacts without resurrecting videos.

caption.vi: Các version chỉ là identifiers của worked history. CAS/transaction phải kiểm current authority tại publish boundary; gắn chữ generation vào payload không tự enforce invariant.
caption.en: Versions identify this worked history. CAS/transactions check current authority at publication boundaries; generation fields alone do not enforce invariants.

paragraphs.vi: Một viral clip tạo hot segments; nhiều unique cold clips tạo origin-read pressure khác. Đo byte hit, request hit, miss latency, fill duplication và regional capacity riêng. Cache key pin content generation/rendition/segment và relevant access context; signed tokens không nên phá sharing vô ích hoặc làm private bytes public. Negative caching cho missing processing outputs phải có bounded expiry.
paragraphs.en: Viral segments and many unique cold clips stress different resources. Measure byte hits, request hits, miss latency, duplicate fills and regional capacity separately. Keys pin generations/renditions/segments and relevant access context. Scope tokens without unnecessary fragmentation or private-data leakage, and bound negative caching for missing outputs.

paragraphs.vi: Thumbnails/images thường nhiều requests nhưng ít bytes, nên metadata lookup, variants và transform admission quan trọng. Sharded SQL giữ creator metadata; browse/search projections có freshness/removal behavior riêng. Replica lag và cache invalidation phải theo promised version, không dùng blanket “eventual” để bỏ privacy constraints.
paragraphs.en: Thumbnails generate many small requests, making lookups, variants and transform admission important. Sharded SQL stores creator metadata while browse/search projections have their own freshness/removal behavior. Replica lag and caching follow version promises rather than using eventual consistency to dismiss privacy constraints.

items.vi: Local popularity và rendition distribution quyết định placement.
items.en: Local popularity and rendition distribution guide placement.

items.vi: Coalesce misses và reserve upstream capacity khi edge fail.
items.en: Coalesce misses and reserve upstream capacity for edge failures.

items.vi: Retain reliable origin và costed storage tiers; không preload toàn catalog.
items.en: Retain reliable origins and costed tiers rather than preloading everything.

items.vi: Rare traffic vẫn cần good first-play, auth và recoverable assets.
items.en: Rarely viewed items still need good first play, authorization and recoverable assets.

items.vi: Shard locality + query budgets; global read models không tự exact/fresh.
items.en: Use shard locality/query budgets; global projections are not automatically exact or fresh.

items.vi: Thumbnail variants và metadata versions không dùng chung arbitrary cache key.
items.en: Thumbnail variants and metadata versions need deliberate cache keys.

paragraphs.vi: Một ranker không nhìn video ngoài candidate pool. Increase K có thể tăng recall nhưng cũng thêm feature fetch/rank batches, chưa chắc tăng satisfaction. Thêm sources giúp exploration/cold start, nhưng dedup và policy eligibility cần rõ; một video blocked có utility giả lập cao vẫn không được show. Filter placement cần budget và safety ở cả pre/post-rank, playback còn reauthorize.
paragraphs.en: Rankers cannot inspect videos outside the candidate pool. Larger pools can improve recall but add feature/ranking work without guaranteeing satisfaction. Additional sources aid exploration/cold starts but need deduplication and policy eligibility. Blocked items remain ineligible even with high utility; filter budgets and playback authorization still apply.

paragraphs.vi: Offline evaluation dùng held-out/judged eligible items hoặc expensive sampled audits để ước lượng candidate recall; labels dễ selection bias từ lịch sử chỉ thấy items đã shown. Monitor model/index freshness, delayed labels, new creators và groups/regions; không claim một logarithmic ANN latency formula giữ nguyên khi corpus tăng 10×.
paragraphs.en: Evaluate recall with eligible judged/held-out items or costly sampled audits. Historical exposure creates selection bias. Monitor freshness, delayed labels, new creators and regions/groups rather than assuming a logarithmic ANN formula remains accurate as the corpus grows.

rows.vi: v03 bị block; ranking không thể tự lấy v11/v15 ngoài pool.
rows.en: v03 is blocked; ranking cannot obtain v11/v15 outside its pool.

rows.vi: Pool v01,v11,v02,v15; shown v15,v11,v02 với cùng ranker.
rows.en: Pool v01,v11,v02,v15; show v15,v11,v02 with the same ranker.

rows.vi: Recall đầy đủ trong tiny fixture vẫn vượt latency budget.
rows.en: Complete recall within this tiny fixture still exceeds the latency budget.

rows.vi: Thêm parallel slots giảm batch count trong model; không tự tạo real capacity.
rows.en: More parallel slots reduce fixture batches rather than create real capacity.

caption.vi: Oracle eligible top 4 là v15,v11,v07,v13; v03 utility 100 bị loại vì policy. Các cost constants là giả định, không ANN benchmark hay guarantee quality.
caption.en: Eligible oracle top 4 is v15,v11,v07,v13; policy excludes v03 despite utility 100. Cost constants are assumptions rather than ANN benchmarks or quality guarantees.

paragraphs.vi: Một codec tiết kiệm bitrate ở matched quality chưa chắc rẻ nếu video ít views, devices không hỗ trợ hoặc extra ladder giữ nhiều tháng. Expected benefits dùng eligible watched duration, không upload duration hoặc impression count. Chọn marginal egress price theo cache/origin topology thực; cost encode/storage cần cùng currency/time horizon.
paragraphs.en: Bitrate savings at matched quality may not repay extra encoding if views are sparse, devices incompatible or storage long-lived. Benefits depend on eligible watched duration rather than upload duration or impressions. Use marginal delivery costs for the actual topology and align currencies/time horizons.

paragraphs.vi: Không coi encode presets có perceptual quality ngang nhau chỉ vì cùng resolution. Benchmark codec/accelerator trên content mix, target quality, audio, playback capability và power. Canaries/rollback cho rendition manifests cần giữ baseline fallback; unsupported codec không được biến playable video thành unsupported.
paragraphs.en: Equal resolution does not prove equal perceptual quality. Benchmark codecs/accelerators against content mixes, quality targets, audio, capabilities and power. Canary manifests with baseline fallbacks so enhanced codecs cannot make existing videos unplayable.

caption.vi: Cùng 20,000 views, 3 phút/view, 1 Mbps bitrate saving và matched quality; marginal egress giả định $0.04/decimal GB, 1 tháng additional storage. Với compatible share khác 0: ceil(15 / (share×180×1/8000×0.04)). Đây không phải giá thị trường.
caption.en: For 20,000 views at 3 minutes/view, 1 Mbps saved and matched quality, assume marginal egress $0.04/decimal GB and 1 month of additional storage. For nonzero compatibility: ceil(15 / (share×180×1/8000×0.04)). These are not market prices.

title.vi: Short-feed prefetch và feedback đúng nghĩa

paragraphs.vi: Prefetch phải ưu tiên current playback, respect data-saver/consent và cancel theo session. Prefix đã tải có thể dùng lại nếu URL/generation/range/integrity/context còn đúng; changing signed tokens không nên làm mất cache vô ích. Prediction depth tăng nhưng link budget không đổi có thể chỉ tải cùng clip 1 và thêm wasted partial bytes.
paragraphs.en: Prioritize current playback, respect data settings/consent and cancel by session. Reuse prefixes only under matching generation/range/integrity/access context. Deeper predictions under fixed bandwidth may warm the same first clip while adding wasted partial bytes.

paragraphs.vi: Tách exposure, visible interval, actual play, buffered bytes, watch duration, swipe và replay/loop. Một retry event dùng stable identity; trusted server-side aggregates vẫn cần semantic dedup và late corrections. Session feedback có recency nhưng không được dùng client clock như ordering authority hay log private viewing context quá mức.
paragraphs.en: Distinguish exposure, visible intervals, playback, buffering, watched duration, swipes and loops. Stable event identities prevent transport duplicates while semantic aggregation still needs deduplication and corrections. Preserve recency without trusting client clocks as authority or over-logging private viewing context.

rows.en: No waste, but the next clip is cold.

rows.en: Clip 1 has a full prefix; clip 2 has only 0.2 MB.

rows.en: Warm starts still waste bytes on early swipes.

title.vi: Live và hardware giữ nguyên correctness contracts
title.en: Live and hardware preserve correctness contracts

paragraphs.vi: Live chia budget theo ingest, encode, package, cache và player; thêm captions/chat/ad decisions không được cản segment deadlines vô hạn. Shared segments giúp coalescing nhưng personalized manifests/auth còn per-session work. Backpressure có thể giảm rendition/quality hoặc reject new sessions theo policy, không unbounded queue làm latency tăng mãi.
paragraphs.en: Allocate live budgets across ingestion, encoding, packaging, caching and players. Captions/chat/ad work must not block segment deadlines indefinitely. Shared segments allow coalescing while personalized manifests/auth retain per-session work. Backpressure can reduce renditions or reject load rather than letting latency grow in unbounded queues.

paragraphs.vi: Accelerators giảm cost một compute path nhưng không sửa missing source integrity, stale policy, bad manifests hay unfair scheduling. Đếm utilization/idle power, batch efficiency, failure replacement, unsupported content fallback và design/operations horizon. Throughput gain đo trên workload/quality cụ thể, không copy universal multiplier từ marketing hoặc một bài benchmark.
paragraphs.en: Accelerators improve a compute path but cannot fix integrity, stale policies, manifests or fairness. Count utilization, idle power, batching, replacement, unsupported-format fallback and design/operating horizons. Throughput gains depend on measured workloads and quality rather than universal published multipliers.

title.vi: Câu hỏi luyện decisions và failure paths
title.en: Questions on decisions and failure paths

question.vi: Upload hoàn tất nhưng chưa playable: giải thích và thiết kế UX thế nào?
question.en: An upload completes but is not playable: what does that mean?

answer.vi: Bytes complete chỉ xác nhận source generation; baseline encode, manifest/dependencies và selected policy/visibility còn có thể pending. Show processing states và retry/error evidence cụ thể; không trả link public hỏng. Publish baseline sớm nếu đủ điều kiện, optional enhancements cập nhật sau bằng versioned manifest. Retry finalize/enqueue giữ stable identity và reconciler lấp missing tasks.
answer.en: Complete bytes establish a source generation while baseline encoding, manifests and policy/visibility may still be pending. Show specific progress/errors instead of broken public links. Publish eligible baselines early and add enhancements through versioned manifests. Stable finalization/enqueue identities and reconciliation cover missing tasks.

question.vi: Có nên đưa toàn catalog vào cache không?
question.en: Should the entire catalog be cached?

answer.vi: Không quyết định chỉ bằng tổng video count. Local demand, generation/rendition mix, byte/request hit, cache capacity/fill cost và origin miss latency mới quyết định hot set. Long tail vẫn có authoritative origin và tiered fallback; direct-origin hay CDN cho rare objects phải compare real contracts/topology. Cache outage cần reserve capacity, không đẩy mọi cold misses vào origin vô hạn.
answer.en: Choose from local demand, rendition mixes, byte/request hits, capacity, fill cost and miss latency rather than total item count. Retain reliable origins and tiered fallback for the tail. Compare actual topology/contracts for rare items and reserve capacity for cache failures instead of forwarding unlimited misses.

question.vi: Tăng candidates có luôn tốt hơn không?

answer.vi: Có thể tăng eligible recall nhưng thêm feature/rank batches và latency; larger noisy pool còn tăng burden cho selection/diversity. Đo recall với held-out/judged eligible targets hoặc sampled audits, rồi online satisfaction/cost. Trong fixture count = 4 single-source recall = 0, multi-source có thể lấy relevant videos dù ranker không đổi. Không fake curve guarantee recall tăng theo một công thức cho mọi corpus.
answer.en: Larger pools can improve eligible recall but add ranking/feature work and selection burden. Measure recall with eligible judged/held-out targets or sampled audits, then online satisfaction and cost. The fixture shows discovery sources recovering useful candidates without changing the ranker. No universal candidate-count formula guarantees recall.

question.vi: Một video 20.000 views có nên encode thêm codec không?
question.en: Should a video with 20,000 views get an extra codec?

answer.vi: Cần compatible watched seconds, matched quality, bitrate saving và marginal prices. Với fixture 3 phút, 1 Mbps saving, $0.04/GB,100% compatible, 20.000 views tiết kiệm450 GB=$18; extra encode $12+1 tháng storage $3 cho net $3. Nếu compatible 50%, savings $9 và net −$6. Đây là assumptions để tính, chưa battery/forecast/failed compute, không universal threshold.
answer.en: Use compatible watched duration, matched quality, bitrate savings and marginal prices. In the fixture, three minutes, 1 Mbps saved, $0.04/GB and full compatibility yield 450 GB/$18 at 20,000 views. A $12 encode plus $3 storage leaves $3; 50% compatibility leaves a $6 loss. Other costs and uncertainty remain excluded.

question.vi: Prefetch depth = 5 vì sao vẫn không warm clip thứ5?
question.en: Why might depth five still leave the fifth clip cold?

answer.vi: Depth là maximum intent, link/window mới giới hạn bytes thật. Trong fixture3.2 Mbps trừ1.2 Mbps current playback còn 2 Mbps; 2 giây chỉ 0.5 MB, đủ 0.3 MB clip 1 và 0.2 MB clip 2. Clip 5 vẫn 0. Startup cho nó cold, trong khi những bytes đã tải có thể waste. Tăng prediction depth không tạo bandwidth; reserve current playback và measure useful bytes.
answer.en: Depth expresses intent, while link capacity and time bound actual bytes. A 3.2 Mbps link reserving 1.2 Mbps leaves 2 Mbps, or 0.5 MB over two seconds: one 0.3 MB prefix and part of the second. Clip five stays cold. Deeper predictions do not create bandwidth; reserve playback and measure useful bytes.

question.vi: Sharding/proxy có làm hết replication lag không?
question.en: Does sharding or adding a proxy eliminate replica lag?

answer.vi: Không. Sharding có thể giảm per-shard load nếu phân bố phù hợp, nhưng replication vẫn có backlog/failure conditions. Proxy route/query-plan/pool và resharding tools không tự cấp zero-loss failover hoặc mọi cross-shard transaction. Read-your-write, rights freshness, hot key handling và migration fencing vẫn phải thiết kế.
answer.en: No. Sharding may reduce load but replication can still lag or fail. Routing/planning/pooling and resharding tools do not automatically provide lossless failover or arbitrary cross-shard transactions. Read-your-write, rights freshness, hotspots and fenced migration remain design work.

question.vi: Fingerprint match có đủ để auto public/block mọi clip?
question.en: Is fingerprint matching sufficient for every publication decision?

answer.vi: Không. Match là evidence theo reference/policy scope và có false positives/disputes; no match không chứng minh safe/allowed. Tách technical readiness khỏi policy lifecycle có versions, reviews/appeals và region/account effects. Playback/current visibility checks và propagation/removal policy cần rõ. Đây là system workflow, không suy legal conclusion từ một hash.
answer.en: No. Matches are scoped evidence with disputes and false positives; missing matches do not prove safety or permission. Separate technical readiness from versioned policy/review workflows and regional/account effects. Keep current playback checks and explicit propagation/removal policies rather than deriving legal conclusions from fingerprints.

question.vi: Tại sao dedicated video chips chưa phải bước đầu tiên?
question.en: Why are dedicated video chips not the first step?

answer.vi: Cần stable workload đủ lớn trả được design/integration/operations và lead time. Trước đó optimize DAG, priority, codec selection và measured general hardware. Accelerator vẫn cần aligned valid outputs, fairness, retry/fallback, spare capacity và deployment compatibility. Benchmark cùng quality/content; throughput gain của một setup không là multiplier cho mọi workload.
answer.en: A stable workload must justify design, integration, operations and lead time. First optimize DAGs, priorities, codec selection and measured general hardware. Accelerators still need valid outputs, fairness, retries/fallbacks, reserves and compatibility. Benchmark matched quality/content rather than applying one setup’s gains universally.
